ravi_cs: FYI SablePay (acct SP) opened an intake for a transaction reranker + embeddings feature. They want hosted pilot first; potential Dedicated later. Main constraints: p99 latency <= 70ms for a 10-candidate rerank (avg title+meta ~ 75 tokens), strict PII redaction (no card/order ids persisted), and per-merchant fairness checks. Pilot timeline: 3 weeks.

olga_sablepay: correct. We'll provide candidate sets from our search and golden reorder labels for ~1.5k requests to start. We can extend to 8k after pilot. Need sync API with occasional batch embedding exports for analytics.

samir_solutions: thanks. We'll aim to test a 7B distilled scorer (q4_0 or q8_0) and measure p99. Hosted may require client-side prefilter to 10 and request batching. If hosted can't hit 70ms p99, recommend Dedicated 2xA10 as fallthrough.

zoe_sre: perf note: 70ms p99 is aggressive if we do separate calls per candidate. Options: run dedicated candidate-scoring (single pass scoring all 10 candidates) or use a pairwise ranker that scores concatenated input with efficient attention kernels. We'll run microbenchmarks.

emily_privacy: Privacy checklist: must redact full PANs/order ids before upload, provide hashed order mappings (customer-salted). No unredacted logs in staging. DPA signed before any persistent storage. Also need explicit consent for embedding exports to analytics store.

olga_sablepay: understood. We'll provide salted hashes and a sample redaction tool we run client-side. We'll only share masked samples for the pilot.

samir_solutions: action items:
1) ingest sample payloads (1.5k seed) and labels  olga_sablepay (ETA 24h)
2) offline eval harness + metrics (NDCG@10, RR@1, per-merchant-slice uplift)  samir_solutions (ETA 4d for seed)
3) perf microbenchmarks on 7B q8_0 + candidate concat experiments  zoe_sre (ETA 3d)
4) privacy signoff + DPA draft  emily_privacy (ETA 5d)
5) enablement call and integration doc  ravi_cs (propose Wed 10am PT)

olga_sablepay: seed upload in progress: sablepay_rerank_seed_v1.tar.gz (8.2MB) - SFTP. Will add hashed mapping once upload completes. Wed 10am PT works.

ingest-bot: Upload received: sablepay_rerank_seed_v1.tar.gz (8.2MB) sftp@incoming 2219998892

zoe_sre: quick perf command we'll run in staging:
```
./bench_rerank --model ./models/7b-scoring-q8 --mode concat --batch 12 --seq 80 --warmup 300 --measure p50,p95,p99
```

samir_solutions: eval acceptance: NDCG@10 uplift >= 0.04 and per-merchant delta < 0.02 for top merchants. If not met we iterate model/feature set.

ravi_cs: risk note: conversion/renewal impact high if pilot fails on latency or privacy. Flagging as customer success priority.

emily_privacy: I'll start DPA draft and share redaction checklist. @olga_sablepay pls confirm you will not send raw order ids.

olga_sablepay: confirmed, no raw order ids. We'll attach hashed mapping and describe our client-side redactor. Thanks team.

ravi_cs: cool. We'll reconvene after perf + seed eval. Drop blockers here. :thumbsup:
